response.title: which whole house battery backup works without solar panels
response.answer:
Yes. Several whole-house battery backup systems work without solar panels. They charge directly from the electric grid when power is available, then automatically power your home during an outage.

This is commonly called a grid-charged home battery backup system.

The important distinction is that some batteries support grid-only installation out of the box, while others require specific inverters, controllers, or configurations.

For a typical U.S. home, I would compare Tesla Powerwall 3, FranklinWH, Enphase IQ Battery 5P, and EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra first.

Supports grid charging, automatic outage backup, and electricity rate optimization without solar.

Best for generator integration

15 kWh capacity · 10 kW output

Grid-only operation, automatic backup, and integration options for standby generators. 
FranklinWH
+1

3. Enphase IQ Battery 5P

Best modular installed system

5 kWh per battery · 3.84 kW continuous output

Supports battery-only whole-home configurations with a compatible IQ System Controller. Multiple batteries are usually needed. 
Inverter Supply

4. EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra

Best expandable portable option

6.144 kWh per battery · 7.2 kW per inverter

Charges from the grid and supports home backup through a compatible home panel. Expandable up to 90 kWh.

How many batteries do you need?

Without solar, your battery cannot recharge during an outage unless another compatible power source is available.

Here is an illustrative runtime comparison assuming 90% of nominal capacity reaches your appliances:

A house running central AC, electric heating, or an EV charger can consume substantially more power.

My recommendation: Start with Tesla Powerwall 3 if you want a permanent, automatic whole-home backup system without solar. Compare FranklinWH if you also have or plan to add a generator.
